Typically this is a trait makers avoid with glitters, but I found the evolution to be alluring, on-par with the theme, and "X-traordinary". Finding Feathers Lacquer will be donating $2 from every bottle of the X-Pression of Pride Collection sold to our friends at JASMYN to aid them in their advocacy for LGBTQIA+ teens and young adults.
